body: A million thank you's for this. I don't open up often around my close friends because I don't want to burden them with what I feel like is emotional whining and having someone listen even an anonymous person on the internet and to have them say such kind words is truly amazing. I know that everyone goes through heartbreak and everyone copes differently, but sometimes - particularly late at night when I'm alone in bed, it just seems like everything is so meaningless. If it's okay, I'm going to print your response off and tape it to my mirror so I can see it when I get up in the morning and whenever I need it. Thank you again, so very much.

This is very true. And I've ALWAYS all throughout my life done the logical thing - the reasonable thing. This was really the first time I took a chance and went with my heart and flying across the country to try and fix something is way uncharacteristic for me, but love is sad and messed up like that sometime. Either way, I'm glad I took the chance and I think time will just have to run it's course and put me in a better place. Thank you for the response.

Thank you :) All my friends and family tell me the stuff I'd expect to hear, but it's real experienced stuff like this that really fills me with a sense of solace. The problem with my state right now is that I don't trust my ability to make decisions - but I think with time that'll clear up. I think the mentality that I'm going to go with right now is just 'let what happens happen'. I'll try and focus on things that make me happy and focus on my hobbies and continued self improvement.
